talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.blight: Burn the grey cold out of me (%s)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.blight_done: There. Hold still while it goes. You'll feel the cold leave you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.refuse_hollow: I won't lay hands on one of the Hollow. Find your own kind's healers.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.0: Gold in dead meat? Are you mad?
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.2: That's good gold wasted on rot.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.3: My grandmother swore by that. Didn't save her, mind.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.4: Ugh. Keep that away from me.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.druid.bottle: Bring me a bottle and I'll draw the cure from that.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.druid.brew.0: Gold and fire. The old way. Drink it before the cold sets in.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.druid.brew.1: The witches keep this from the villages. I never would.
blight_cures.jaymoskingdoms.druid.brew.2: There. Carry it to whoever has the grey on them.
research.jaymoskingdoms.druid_remedies.l: You learned the druids' way with the Hollow's Cure: gilded flesh worked into a boiling cauldron, drawn off into a bottle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight_cures.stud: You'd need to study the druids' remedies first, with a sage or at a library.
